lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: domain, range, and function notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

steps: Input 1 appears twice with different outputs.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 95 components and consumes 2 per hour. It can run for at most 28 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 95 − 2h in this context?
A sequence is defined by a(1) = 8 and a(n) = a(n − 1) + 4 for n > 1. Find a(23).
In a modelling context, the graph of a cooling object’s temperature flattens out towards a horizontal line. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: a maximum, giving the hottest temperature
a zero, giving the time the object freezes
an end behaviour approaching the surrounding temperature

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 9)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.
Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 100 components and consumes 2 per hour. It can run for at most 21 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 100 − 2h in this context?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = -7 and a(n) = a(n − 1) − 3 for n > 1. Find a(19).
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In a modelling context, the graph of a projectile’s height against time reaches its highest point. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
